content.name: Colleen Ballinger (Miranda Sings apology video)
content.description: Colleen Ballinger, known for her character Miranda Sings, in the viral ukulele apology video. This image became widely recognized online as part of a controversial apology video.

scene_context: This image is from Colleen Ballinger's infamous ukulele apology video, which became a viral meme and reaction image in 2023. The video was widely mocked and remixed online for its tone and delivery.

meme.template_name: Ukulele Apology Video / Colleen Ballinger Apology
meme.meaning: Used to mock insincere or performative apologies, or to sarcastically express regret for trivial matters. The image is often captioned to highlight awkward, tone-deaf, or self-serving apologies.
meme.how_a_caption_should_use_it: A caption should set up a scenario where someone is making an over-the-top or obviously fake apology, with the image delivering the punchline of an awkward or performative apology.
example_captions: When you get caught eating your roommate's snacks and try to apologize.
Me after saying 'no offense' and immediately offending someone.
When your teacher asks who didn't do the homework and you try to look sorry.
